suites.selection_note: the optional MDAnalysis adapter test now reports as skipped rather than deselected

execution_note: Offline reviewer-scope run of this command-line distribution. Suites are invoked in separate pytest processes because legacy suites contain duplicate test module and conftest names; python tools/run_structural_workbench_tests.py is the authoritative runner and bare pytest does not work. The private control plane and the loopback browser controller are outside this distribution and contribute no tests to this baseline. Cross-platform clean-install evidence remains a separate recorded gate.
architecture_note: Recorded on arm64 (Apple Silicon) with an arm64 interpreter. An interpreter whose architecture does not match the machine can install wheels whose compiled extensions fail to load; the runner's preflight checks declared versions, not architecture, so that failure arrives later as pytest collection errors. See Running the tests in README.md.
reference_platform_change: The preceding baseline (2026-09-02, 526 passed) was recorded on Python 3.12.7 from an x86_64 conda under Rosetta. That interpreter no longer satisfies this project's declared floors -- it carries biopython 1.78 against a >=1.81 requirement -- so the runner's preflight refuses it and it cannot produce a valid baseline. A virtual environment derived from it installs arm64 wheels whose compiled extensions will not load on an x86_64 interpreter. The reference platform therefore moved to arm64 for a stated reason, not a preference: it is the only locally available interpreter that satisfies the declared dependency set, and it matches the arm64 macos-latest runner already used in CI. Comparisons against the 2026-09-02 baseline should account for the platform change as well as the added suites.
scientific_boundary: Passing software tests are not passing external scientific qualification benchmarks.
